text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Victory in the Kikuka Sho, the final leg 
of the Classic Triple Crown. Defeating her 
formidable rival Special Week, the venue 
erupted in cheers for Seiun Sky, the star 
of the day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Praising each other for their fierce 
battle in the Classics alongside Special 
Week. Meanwhile, King Halo, the other 
member of the Big Three, watched the two 
of them with visible frustration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home, Seiun Sky—who hadn't 
decided on her next race— hears from a fan 
that Grass Wonder will be running in the 
Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Defeat Grass Wonder and become the 
strongest of the generation. Driven to 
answer the fans' expectations, Seiun Sky 
set her sights on the Arima Kinen.
